appearance.subtle: Their skin tone seems to shift slightly against the wall behind them.
appearance.obvious: Their exposed skin is running with slow colour, matching the room a half-second behind.
appearance.extreme: When they stop moving they are very difficult to look at directly. The wall continues across them, and your eye keeps sliding off.

description: Your skin reads what is behind you and matches it. Hold still and there is very little of you to see.
drawbacks: It does it whether or not you asked
name: Chameleon Skin
